title: Calibrate signal intensity ranges for Pattern A and Pattern B relational appraisal outputs
objective: Determine whether Pattern A (Contested Endorsement) and Pattern B (High-Intensity Unilateral Disclosure) should produce differentiated signal intensities relative to P0 (confrontation/withdrawal), implement any approved differentiation within the settlement-safe envelope, lock the calibrated ranges into the behavior contract document, and add tests that confirm the ranges hold.
exact_scope: The scope covers three bounded decisions and their implementation artifacts. First: evaluate whether the uniform signal shape currently shared by P0, Pattern A, and Pattern B is the correct calibrated state or whether Pattern A and Pattern B warrant distinct field values. The rationale must be written down — either 'uniform shape is intentional and here is why' or 'Pattern A/B differ in arousal and here is why'. Second: if differentiation is approved, update the three AppraisalSignal return blocks in build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick() in tick_bridge.py, staying within the hard stops already enforced by the contract (no strong_decrease, no risk_delta != 0, no aftershock_days > 0 on base signal, absorption ceiling at deep, closeness_delta floor at -2 post-adjustment). Third: update docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Section 8 to replace the current 'identical to Pattern A' shorthand with explicit field tables for each pattern that reflect the calibrated values. Fourth: add tests to back/tests/test_t4_behavior_contract.py (or a new test module) that verify the calibrated base signal fields for each pattern independently, confirm the hard caps still hold after _adjust_t4(), and confirm that Pattern A and Pattern B remain mutually exclusive and non-overlapping with P0. No changes to tick precedence order, no new event types, no new SocialEventSpec fields, no changes to _adjust_t4() logic, no changes to AppraisalSignal schema.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 is frozen — do not modify its field definitions
T4 old deterministic path (P0 — confrontation/withdrawal) is frozen — do not modify the P0 signal output block
trust_shift must never reach strong_decrease on any base signal or via _adjust_t4() residual adjustment
aftershock_days must be 0 on the base signal for all patterns — the Phase 23 wake gate may only open via _adjust_t4() when a carried negative relational residual is present
absorption on the base signal must not exceed surface for any new negative path — partial and deep are only reachable via _adjust_t4()
risk_delta must remain 0 on all T4 negative base signals
Do not expand T4 to new event types not already in the catalog — Pattern A and Pattern B are the only approved expansions
Do not modify T3, T5, T6, T7, T8 bridge coverage — those ticks remain deferred
Settlement remains the engine's responsibility — the bridge only produces signals
All calibration decisions must be documented in docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md with explicit numerical field values, not references to other patterns
acceptance_criteria: Each of the three negative T4 patterns (P0, Pattern A, Pattern B) has an explicit, independently stated base signal field table in docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md — no pattern's specification may say 'identical to' another
The behavior contract document states a written calibration rationale for why each pattern's arousal, trust_shift, and closeness_delta values were chosen as-is (uniform or differentiated)

If Pattern A or Pattern B signal shapes are changed from the current uniform values, the updated values must remain within: absorption=surface, valence=negative, arousal in {low, medium}, trust_shift in {mild_decrease}, closeness_delta in {-1, -2} (base only), risk_delta=0, aftershock_days=0, guidance_resonance=neutral
The tick_bridge.py AppraisalSignal return blocks for Pattern A and Pattern B reflect the calibrated values from the contract document — the code and the doc are in agreement
All 454 existing tests continue to pass after any changes
New tests exist that verify the exact base signal field values for Pattern A independently (not inferred from P0 or Pattern B)
New tests exist that verify the exact base signal field values for Pattern B independently
New tests exist that verify post-_adjust_t4() hard caps still hold for Pattern A and Pattern B when a carried negative relational residual is present
New tests exist that confirm Pattern A does not activate when reciprocity is not contested (mutual or unilateral endorsements fall through to default positive path)
New tests exist that confirm Pattern B does not activate when intensity is low or moderate, or when reciprocity is not unilateral
required_tests: Pattern A base signal returns exactly the calibrated absorption, valence, arousal, trust_shift, closeness_delta, risk_delta, aftershock_days, and guidance_resonance values when a contested endorsement event is present

Pattern B base signal returns exactly the calibrated absorption, valence, arousal, trust_shift, closeness_delta, risk_delta, aftershock_days, and guidance_resonance values when a high-intensity unilateral disclosure event is present
After _adjust_t4() is called with a carried negative relational residual against a Pattern A base signal, trust_shift does not exceed mild_decrease and closeness_delta does not go below -2
After _adjust_t4() is called with a carried negative relational residual against a Pattern B base signal, trust_shift does not exceed mild_decrease and closeness_delta does not go below -2
An endorsement event with reciprocity=mutual produces the default positive path, not Pattern A
An endorsement event with reciprocity=unilateral produces the default positive path, not Pattern A
A disclosure event with intensity=low and reciprocity=unilateral produces the default positive path, not Pattern B
A disclosure event with intensity=moderate and reciprocity=unilateral produces the default positive path, not Pattern B
A disclosure event with intensity=high and reciprocity=mutual produces the default positive path, not Pattern B
A disclosure event with intensity=high and reciprocity=contested produces the default positive path, not Pattern B
non_goals: Do not differentiate signal shapes based on social_event.visibility, social_event.expectedness, or social_event.resolution — those attributes are not inspected in the T4 builder
Do not introduce arousal=high or absorption=partial on any base signal for Pattern A or Pattern B — these levels are only reachable via _adjust_t4()
Do not introduce a risk_delta > 0 for any pattern
Do not add new social event patterns beyond Pattern A and Pattern B
Do not modify the _adjust_t4() function logic
Do not add target_id routing based on social_event.target_id
Do not generate world events or modify the world generator to produce qualifying events
Do not modify the frontend observation UI
